newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Singapore rubber futures market is closed on Friday for a holiday. The market will reopen on Monday, March 31.
On Thursday, the May RSS3 contract settled at 120 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 121.00 cents.

The May RSS1 settled at 173.50 Singapore cents (US$1.20) a kg from 175.00 cents. The May TSR20 contract finished at 161.75 Singapore cents (US$1.12) a kg against 162.50 cents. The October/December TSR20 contract finished at 118.00 U.S. cents a kg against the previous 118.50 cents.
